title: Water Treatment Company for Sale in Mumbai, India
tagline: The company provides toxic water treatment services. - Currently, the business has 40 active clients. - It follows a project-led, value-based revenue model, combining proprietary equipment (catalyst filtration, nanobubbles, oxidation systems) with engineering and EPC services. - The plant has a capacity of 1 MLD, with utilization fully dependent on each client’s requirements; the amount of water treated varies daily. - The recent revenue dip is due to reduced business development activity, not market or technical weaknesses. - The company is led by a senior scientist-cum-engineer with over three decades of process engineering experience and has built strong relationships with global players such as Reliance Industries and Bayer. - Its differentiation lies in delivering cost savings through resource recovery and energy-efficient, sustainable solutions, aligned with ZLD and ESG goals. - The business holds pollution and municipal licenses, is GST-registered, and operates as a Private Limited company. - The business is registered in Palghar, but its operating headquarters are in Mumbai.
